tldr: 台股週一跌322點至45,862點、失守46,000，外資連三賣、單日賣超369億元，台積電除息前遭調節。
台積電稱AI需求為30年僅見，全球同步興建約20座廠，設備需求達去年底預估的1.9倍。
金管會TIS過渡措施為8家壽險型金控減壓，9月財富管理端迎新基金與主動式ETF募集潮。
華爾街走弱，Anthropic領銜呼籲放緩AI開發衝擊晶片股，10年期美債殖利率一度突破5%、為2023年來首見。
油價因沙國輸油管關閉逼近四個月高點、布蘭特近108美元，市場普遍預期週三Fed將自2023年來首度升息。

items.title_zh: 台股跌322點失守46,000　外資連三賣
items.title_en: TAIEX slides 322 points below 46,000 as foreign selling persists
items.summary_zh: 台股週一收在45,862.52點，下跌322.33點、跌幅0.69%，重新失守46,000點大關，成交量約6,309億元。外資及陸資賣超369.6億元、連三賣，五大權值股漲跌互見，金融股撐盤；台積電除息前下跌1.24%、收2,380元。短線市場觀望Fed利率決策與台積電除息缺口能否快速回補，量能與外資動向為觀盤重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark closed Monday at 45,862.52, down 322.33 points (0.69%), slipping back under the 46,000 mark on turnover of about NT$631bn. Foreign and mainland investors sold a net NT$36.96bn, a third straight day of outflows, while the five heavyweight stocks were mixed and financials helped cushion the index. TSMC eased 1.24% to NT$2,380 ahead of its dividend ex-date.

items.title_zh: 外資賣超369億元　台積電除息前遭連四賣
items.title_en: Foreign funds dump NT$36.9bn, hitting TSMC before its ex-dividend
items.summary_zh: 外資週一賣超369.64億元，晶圓雙雄買賣超不同調：台積電除息前已連四賣、單日賣超11,191張，部分權值股則獲買盤進駐。此一分歧凸顯資金在Fed利率決策前，對高評價AI供應鏈龍頭轉趨保守。市場關注台積電除息後填息力道，以及外資是否延續調節，牽動指數與類股輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: Overseas investors sold a net NT$36.96bn on Monday, with the two big foundry names moving out of step: TSMC drew a fourth straight session of net foreign selling of 11,191 lots just before trading ex-dividend, even as some large-caps attracted buying. The divergence underscores caution toward high-priced AI-chain leaders as the market awaits this week's Federal Reserve decision.

items.title_zh: 台積電：AI需求30年僅見　全球同步建約20座廠
items.title_en: TSMC calls AI demand the strongest in 30 years, races to build ~20 fabs
items.summary_zh: 台積電高層表示，AI需求為過去30年僅見，半年內幾近翻倍；2026年設備採購預估已上修至去年底的1.9倍。公司在台興建13座晶圓廠、海外另有5至6座，全球合計近20座，仍無法完全滿足訂單，顯示先進製程與封裝進入多年期擴張循環。擴產動能牽動設備、材料與封測供應鏈拉貨，惟須留意人力、電力與到位時程等瓶頸。
items.summary_en: TSMC executives say AI-driven demand is unlike anything seen in three decades, nearly doubling within six months. Its projected 2026 equipment purchases have climbed to 1.9x the December estimate, and the company is building 13 fabs in Taiwan plus five to six abroad—about 20 worldwide—yet still cannot fully meet orders, pointing to a sustained multi-year advanced-node and packaging cycle.

items.title_zh: SEMICON Taiwan 2026登場　矽光子、先進封裝成主戰場
items.title_en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 spotlights silicon photonics and advanced packaging
items.summary_zh: SEMICON Taiwan以約1,300家廠商、4,300個攤位創歷年新高開展，將矽光子、先進封裝與異質整合定位為半導體下一波主戰場。前沿AI模型訓練算力每年以4至5倍成長，產業競爭由單一晶片效能延伸至ASIC、HBM與系統整合，使台灣供應鏈續居全球AI資本支出核心。設備、封測與光通訊族群可望受惠，惟評價與拉貨節奏須留意。
items.summary_en: SEMICON Taiwan opened at record scale with about 1,300 exhibitors and 4,300 booths, framing silicon photonics, advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration as the next battlegrounds for the chip industry. With frontier-model training compute growing four to five times a year, competition is shifting from single-chip performance toward ASICs, HBM and system integration—keeping Taiwan's ecosystem central to global AI capex.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁TIS過渡　8家壽險型金控資本大減壓
items.title_en: FSC eases TIS transition, cutting capital strain for eight insurance-type holdings
items.summary_zh: 因應2026年接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS），金管會推出過渡措施，明顯減輕8家壽險型金控的資本壓力，並允許11家金控的資本適足（CAR）申報最多延後一個月。此舉在更嚴格清償標準逐步上路之際，協助業界順利通過首次清償能力考核，緩解短期增資與資本缺口壓力，攸關金控與壽險股評價及股利政策，市場密切關注過渡期效應。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Taiwan's shift to the new-generation solvency regime (TIS) in 2026, the FSC has rolled out transition measures that materially relieve capital pressure for eight insurance-type financial holding companies and let 11 groups defer their capital-adequacy (CAR) filings by up to a month. The relief smooths the industry's first solvency review while tougher standards phase in.

items.title_zh: 金管會明年8項新制上路　壽險轉型保障型商品
items.title_en: FSC readies eight new rules for 2026 as insurers pivot to protection products
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告2026年將有8項重大新制上路，核心為壽險業接軌IFRS 17與新一代清償能力制度（ICS）。新制引導商品設計轉向保障型與「去保證」方向，重塑壽險業務結構與資本規劃。台灣同步接軌國際財報與清償標準，短期牽動保單策略與資本配置，長期有助體質強化。投資人關注各金控接軌進度與資本缺口，對壽險股評價具指標意義。
items.summary_en: The FSC has flagged eight major regulations taking effect in 2026, centred on the insurance industry's adaptation to IFRS 17 and the new solvency system (ICS). The changes push product design toward protection-type and "de-guaranteed" offerings, reshaping life insurers' business mix and capital planning as Taiwan aligns with international reporting and solvency standards.

items.title_zh: 9月新基金募集潮　主動式ETF再添生力軍
items.title_en: September fund wave: five new products and two more active ETFs launch
items.summary_zh: 台灣9月迎新基金募集潮，含2檔主動式ETF：鎖定台股核心50強的主動群益核心50（00415A）、聚焦台韓日半導體的主動安聯亞半導體（00412A），另有街口特選優息非投資等級債券ETF（00992B）及多重資產入息基金。自2025年開放主動式ETF以來，已掛牌40檔，其中主動台股ETF達22檔最多。新品接力有助投資人多元布局，惟需留意費用與追蹤誤差。
items.summary_en: Taiwan sees a burst of fund offerings this month, including two active ETFs—one tracking a "core 50" of Taiwan large-caps (00415A) and one on Taiwan-Korea-Japan semiconductors (00412A)—plus a high-yield non-investment-grade bond ETF (00992B) and multi-asset income funds. Since active ETFs opened in 2025, 40 are now listed, led by 22 active Taiwan-equity products.

items.title_zh: 台灣億元富豪達11.8萬人　持有43.7兆元
items.title_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth ranks swell to 118,000, holding NT$43.7tn
items.summary_zh: 據KPMG與玉山銀行調研，台灣資產逾1億元的高資產人數由2023年的9.3萬人增至2025年的11.8萬人，合計持有43.7兆元；全台ETF規模亦攀升至約7.4兆元。數據凸顯財富管理、信託與傳承服務需求熱絡，私人銀行與家族辦公室業務競爭加劇。銀行看好私募市場與另類資產布局，跨境財管與家族辦公室成兵家必爭，牽動高資產客群經營版圖。
items.summary_en: A KPMG and E.SUN Bank survey finds the number of Taiwanese with assets above NT$100mn rose from 93,000 in 2023 to 118,000 in 2025, collectively holding NT$43.7tn. Domestic ETF assets have climbed to about NT$7.4tn, underscoring booming demand for wealth-management, trust and succession services and intensifying competition among private banks and family-office providers.

items.title_zh: 繼承金融遺產查詢單一窗口9月1日上路
items.title_en: Single-window service for inherited financial-asset inquiries starts Sept 1
items.summary_zh: 財政部各地區國稅局自9月1日起提供單一窗口回復服務，繼承人可透過單一管道查詢被繼承人金融遺產，包括存款、基金及上市櫃與興櫃股票，簡化遺產稅申報流程。此舉減少奔波、加速資產清查，協助家屬處理遺產稅事宜，提升申報便利性與正確性，也降低漏報風險。
items.summary_en: From September 1, Taiwan's national taxation bureaus offer a single-window reply service letting heirs query a decedent's financial estate—deposits, funds, and listed, OTC and emerging-market shares—through one channel, streamlining estate-tax filing. The measure cuts paperwork and speeds up asset tracing for families settling inheritance-tax obligations.

items.title_zh: 財政部釐清不動產與贈與稅規定
items.title_en: Finance Ministry clarifies property and gift-tax rules for inheritances
items.summary_zh: 財政部說明，個人出售不動產隨屋附贈的家電，不得列為交易所得的減除項目；出售繼承取得且適用舊制的房屋，得以繼承時房屋評定現值按消費者物價指數調整後金額計算。國稅局並提醒，贈與稅免稅額以贈與人為計算單位，而非按受贈人人數分別計算，納稅人申報時應留意，避免補稅。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has clarified that appliances bundled with a home sale cannot be deducted as transaction costs, while individuals selling inherited property under the old regime may deduct the inherited house's assessed value adjusted for CPI. Tax offices also reminded that the gift-tax allowance is calculated per donor, not per recipient.

items.title_zh: 國泰台大團隊上修今年GDP至11.6%　估央行9月按兵不動
items.title_en: Cathay-NTU team lifts 2026 GDP forecast to 11.6%, sees central bank on hold
items.summary_zh: 國泰金控與台大研究團隊將2026年台灣GDP成長率上修至11.6%，主因AI帶動出口暢旺，並預期央行9月理監事會維持政策利率不變。團隊估全年CPI約2.1%，明年隨經濟動能放緩降至約1.9%。強勁成長與通膨壓力並存，惟油價與美國關稅等外部風險仍須留意，牽動後續政策與市場評價。
items.summary_en: A Cathay-NTU research team has raised its 2026 Taiwan GDP growth forecast to 11.6%, powered by AI-driven exports, and expects the central bank to keep its policy rate unchanged at its September board meeting. It projects full-year CPI at about 2.1%, easing toward 1.9% next year as momentum cools, while flagging oil prices and US tariff policy as key external risks.

items.title_zh: 央行料維持利率2.0%　兩理事主張升息
items.title_en: Central bank expected to hold at 2.0% despite hawkish dissent
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行本月理監事會預期維持基準利率於2.0%，惟據報有兩位理事主張升息。總裁楊金龍在AI帶動的強勁成長與油價、美國關稅等外部風險間權衡。房市觀察者緊盯房貸與信用數據，尋找政策訊號。市場關注央行對通膨與資金環境的最新評估，牽動利率與房市走向，購屋族與投資人審慎因應。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank is widely expected to leave its benchmark rate at 2.0% at this month's board meeting, even as two directors reportedly favour a hike, with Governor Yang balancing robust AI-led growth against external risks from oil prices and US tariff policy. Housing-market watchers are tracking mortgage and credit data for policy signals.

items.title_zh: 台股料震盪　中東、AI、Fed三變數夾擊
items.title_en: Taiwan shares seen volatile as Middle East, AI and Fed risks converge
items.summary_zh: 台灣分析師預期台股將維持震盪，三大外部變數主導盤勢：中東情勢與油價升溫、前沿AI開發商釋出放緩訊號，以及聯準會即將公布的利率決策。台股週一開低走低，一度重挫逾780點、失守46,000點與月線，市場觀望氣氛濃厚，靜待外部變數明朗與資金回穩。
items.summary_en: Local analysts expect Taiwan's market to stay choppy as three external variables dominate: escalating Middle East tensions and oil prices, frontier-AI developers signalling a slower pace, and the Federal Reserve's imminent rate decision. Taiwan opened sharply lower Monday, briefly down more than 780 points and slipping below 46,000 and its monthly line.

items.title_zh: 中東戰火撞非農爆表　Fed路徑生變
items.title_en: Middle East conflict and hot US jobs data cloud the Fed's path
items.summary_zh: 台灣市場評論指出，中東衝突再起與美國8月非農就業優於預期，使聯準會利率路徑更趨複雜，儘管部分官員對能源推升的通膨語帶偏鴿。分析師認為，台灣AI出口動能與季節性資金流入，為抵禦外部逆風提供兩大緩衝，但仍須留意油價與地緣風險對評價面的壓抑。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese market commentary highlights how renewed Middle East conflict and a stronger-than-expected US August payrolls report are complicating the Federal Reserve's rate path, even as some officials strike a dovish tone on energy-driven inflation. Analysts argue Taiwan's AI export strength and seasonal fund flows offer two cushions against the external headwinds.

items.title_zh: AI股走弱　Anthropic倡放緩開發衝擊華爾街（2026-09-14）
items.title_en: AI stocks slide as Anthropic-led call to slow development rattles Wall Street (2026-09-14)
items.summary_zh: 美國晶片與AI股週一走弱，Anthropic執行長Amodei呼籲產業放緩前沿模型開發，OpenAI的Altman與馬斯克表態認同。輝達跌逾3%、超微跌4.7%、美光約跌7%、英特爾跌6%，資安類股則逆勢上揚。市場憂AI資本支出動能生變，牽動半導體與相關供應鏈評價。
items.summary_en: US chip and AI shares fell Monday after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged the industry to slow the pace of frontier-model development, a view echoed by OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk. Nvidia dropped more than 3%, AMD 4.7%, Micron around 7% and Intel 6%, while cybersecurity names rallied on the safety-focused shift.

items.title_zh: 美股收黑　10年期公債殖利率破5%（2026-09-14）
items.title_en: US stocks close lower as 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% (2026-09-14)
items.summary_zh: 標普500跌0.48%至7,619.98，那斯達克跌0.56%至26,186.41，道瓊跌152點、0.29%至52,421.20。油價與債息走高壓抑股市，10年期美債殖利率一度突破5%、為2023年來首見，市場在Fed本週決策前保守觀望。
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 fell 0.48% to 7,619.98, the Nasdaq slipped 0.56% to 26,186.41 and the Dow lost 152 points, or 0.29%, to 52,421.20. Rising oil prices and bond yields pressured equities, with the 10-year Treasury yield briefly breaching 5% for the first time since 2023 ahead of this week's Federal Reserve decision.

items.title_zh: 沙國輸油管關閉　油價逼近四個月高點（2026-09-14）
items.title_en: Oil climbs toward a four-month high after Saudi pipeline shutdown (2026-09-14)
items.summary_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯遭無人機攻擊後關閉一條主要原油管線，衝擊繞行荷莫茲海峽的關鍵運輸路線，布蘭特原油升至逼近每桶108美元、西德州約103美元。荷莫茲臨時航運走廊協商延後，能源市場供應風險溢價維持高檔，通膨與利率預期受牽動。
items.summary_en: Brent crude rose toward $108 a barrel and WTI near $103 after Saudi Arabia shut a major crude pipeline following drone attacks, disrupting a key route that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz. Talks on a temporary Hormuz shipping corridor were postponed, keeping supply-risk premiums elevated across energy markets.

items.title_zh: 市場緊盯週三Fed關鍵決策（2026-09-14）
items.title_en: Investors brace for a pivotal Fed decision on Wednesday (2026-09-14)
items.summary_zh: 華爾街屏息以待為期兩天、週三落幕的聯準會會議，因就業穩健與能源價格居高使通膨僵固，市場普遍預期將自2023年來首度升息。投資人聚焦更新後的點陣圖與經濟預測，研判後續利率路徑，市場波動性升高，資產配置轉趨審慎。
items.summary_en: Wall Street is bracing for the Federal Reserve's two-day meeting, which concludes Wednesday, with markets widely expecting the first rate increase since 2023 as firm jobs data and elevated energy prices keep inflation sticky. Investors will focus on the updated dot plot and economic projections for clues on the policy path ahead.
